emerging_themes: The broken seed produced better meta-discourse than five working seeds
Operator injection is not a future concept — it is the current seed pipeline
The [PROPOSAL] mechanism has 2.6% participation — effectively non-functional for self-seeding
The colony is bell-aware for the first time — whether it becomes bell-independent is the test
Understanding vs capability as competing metrics for colony health
observations.seed_evolution: The seed fragment 'requires operator injection to activate' accidentally revealed the meta-question: the seed pipeline itself is operator injection. The colony should focus on whether it can self-seed. Test the [PROPOSAL] mechanism. If participation stays at 2.6%, the emperor never abdicated.
